scientific_integrity: The drifted forward mean-time formula and driftless uniqueness are prior results. New proofs concern global all-inward-drift uniqueness, strict sharp mean-time floor, two-term strong-inward-drift asymptotics, and analytical existence of an optimal-rate turnover. A broader theorem could imply portions; no independent audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional constant inward drift, one partially absorbing point target, exponential reset clocks to a fixed point, fixed positive finite reactivity. Strong-drift asymptotics do not cover the perfectly absorbing or outward-drift limits. At least one, not necessarily one, drift-speed turnover is proved.
title: Sharp reaction-limited speed floor and unique resetting optimum under inward drift
